:::{#def-conditional-surprisal}
#### Conditional surprisal

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,
the **conditional surprisal** of a [value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization) $y$ given a value $x$
with $\P(X=x) > 0$ and $\P(Y=y \mid X=x) > 0$ is

$$\surprisalf{y \mid x} \eqdef -\log \P(Y=y \mid X=x).$$

:::
